name: claude-mods
description: Mark Hickey's Claude Code mods: Linear and PR watch, cortex mesh toasts, safe repo sync. Each installs on its own.

plugins.name: linear-watch
plugins.description: Linear Watch + PR Watch: your Linear tickets and their PRs above the prompt, with /tickets and /prs panes

plugins.name: mesh-toast
plugins.description: A toast for each new cortex mesh message

plugins.name: mesh-toaster
plugins.description: A toaster above the prompt that pops up when mesh mail arrives

plugins.name: repo-sync
plugins.description: Every 14 hours, safely fast-forwards the repos in ~/projects and toasts what changed
